alienware-aw2524hf.bestFor: Competitive FPS players with a compact desk and a GPU that can sustain very high frame rates.
alienware-aw2524hf.reason: The 24.5-inch 1080p format keeps the whole HUD in view while the native 480Hz mode targets high-FPS competitive play.
alienware-aw2524hf.limitation: The 500Hz mode is an overclocked mode and the display still needs a DisplayPort connection and a compatible GPU; confirm the monitor's exact VESA pattern and weight before using an arm.

lg-27gp850-b.reason: The 27-inch QHD combination gives a useful detail and workspace step up while retaining a high refresh rate for games.
